name: Millumin
hint: a column number (3), next, previous, or a column name. Set the device's port to the one in Millumin's OSC settings

rules.source: Millumin's OSC documentation wiki (github.com/anome/millumin-dev-kit) lists /action/launchNextColumn with no argument
Millumin's OSC documentation wiki lists /action/launchPreviousColumn with no argument
Millumin's OSC documentation wiki lists /action/launchColumn with one argument, a column index or name. A forum user reported a 5.12 oddity with an integer index: check on the real Millumin
Millumin's OSC documentation wiki shows a column name as the argument (for example ["test"])
